description: Ministry of Co-operative Development Eastern Province - Conferment of powers of the Co-operative Societies
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Krishnapillai Thurairajasingham) in his capacity as Minister and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities (Agriculture, Irrigation, Animal Production and Development, Fisheries, Co-operative Development, Food and Distribution of Eastern Province). It also confers specific powers to named individuals (Rajinie Ganeshapillai, etc.) with detailed descriptions of their authority under specific sections of the Co-operative Societies Law. This combination of named government personnel with detailed responsibilities and powers makes it a Hybrid gazette (Type 3).
